Class InitRunner

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.InitRunner
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.boot.ApplicationRunner
@Component public class InitRunner extends Object implements org.springframework.boot.ApplicationRunner
The InitRunner type starts services that Spring does not start by itself. Spring is the application framework that calls run(ApplicationArguments) after the context is ready. The type starts the SSH chat listener. SSH is the secure-shell protocol a chat client uses to connect.

      public void run(org.springframework.boot.ApplicationArguments args)
      The run method starts the SSH chat server. Spring calls this method after the application context is ready. The args value is the set of application arguments Spring collected. The method does not read those arguments.
